delivery_head: set by the commit that adds this file
nature: zero-side-effect read-only mechanism analysis of the ROUND66 late-adaptation null result

task1_action_emission_equivalence.outcome_fields_that_differ_note: wall-clock runtime only; on_time, spent_bytes, emissions, discovered, expired, unassigned, completed, active, budget_used_fraction, normalised_cost_total and task_reward_total are identical in every cell

task23_probability_panel.mechanism: softmax saturation: dp/dm = p(1-p) ~ 0.002 at p ~ 0.999, so a mean logit move of 0.55-1.43 (max 2.62) yields at most 0.0140 of probability change and zero argmax flips; 140 of 300 late free records are at p = 1.0 exactly in float32 where the gain is zero

gate_prior_trainable_role.interpretation: measured zero on a live graph, not an absent reading; the beta=1.00 prior still shapes the frozen early path but can no longer move a trainable parameter

missing_fields: per-update lambda_history is not carried in the batch record
gate_diag exists only for diag updates 0, 15 and 31 and is absent elsewhere

task5_focal_attribution_probe.conclusion: ROUND60 full training flipped the early head's decision on the focal key target for s11 and s33 (0.89 and 0.72 probability swings on a non-saturated row), reproducing ROUND60's observed focal losses including the s33 greedy-only asymmetry; ROUND66 froze exactly this path, which is why target-5 is preserved for all three seeds

conclusions_retained: NEW and BC are identical action-for-action and message-for-message on all 192 eval cells and 6 focal cells
the null result is explained by softmax saturation of the only head that moved, not by an absence of learning
late_head really moved (L2 0.090/0.237/0.116) and its logits moved by mean 0.55-1.43 on the visited late states, but p(1-p) ~ 0.002 damps that into at most 0.0140 of probability change
the late actor gradient was 4-6 orders of magnitude below the critic gradients because p ~ 1 makes d(log pi)/dlogits ~ (1-p)
the beta=1.00 gate prior has no remaining trainable path under the frozen early path
the early key target 1700027/target-5 is preserved because its first report routes to the frozen early head
conclusions_deferred: no claim that late-head training is generally inert; only that it was saturated on the states this frozen policy visits
no single-cause attribution of the null result; freezing, saturation, the thin late signal, the inert dual update and the never-binding clip all co-occur
no claim about the unsampled 35.6% of distinct late non-free inputs or the 98.7% of early non-free inputs
the focal attribution probe covers 3 inputs, not a census of ROUND60's early-path changes
no generalisation, non-inferiority, deployment or confirmation-set claim; the 1800000-1800031 block remains an already-used development block
